name: nccl-log-rca-bench
description: A dataset of NCCL (GPU communication) logs designed to evaluate models' ability to perform root-cause analysis and diagnostics on distributed training failures. It measures how well models can interpret log patterns, identify fault types, and propose corrective actions.
reputation: Specialized dataset primarily used in systems/debugging research and by practitioners diagnosing GPU communication issues; adoption is limited but relevant to HPC and ML infra communities.
